title: Resolve declared built-in executor for imported Skills
goal: Make the supported text.normalize executor declaration in Skill.md resolve for imported Skill IDs while keeping unregistered executor names fail-closed.
context: SkillMarkdownParser persists the manifest executor field as metadata, but SkillRuntime.resolveExecutor currently ignores that field and only resolves a registered executor by Skill ID, the canonical text.normalize ID, or an explicit moduleID. An imported Skill that declares the supported built-in executor under another ID remains undispatchable.
forbidden_changes: Do not dynamically load or instantiate arbitrary executor names from untrusted Skill.md metadata.
Do not change policy, capability grants, ModuleRuntime behavior, UI, or Xcode project files.
Do not claim full Skill-to-Tool integration from support for this one built-in executor.
acceptance_criteria: A Skill manifest with metadata executor=text.normalize resolves the built-in normalizer even when its Skill ID differs.
Registered per-Skill executors retain precedence over metadata aliases.
Unknown executor names do not become executable code by declaration alone.
Regression tests cover execution and verification of the imported Skill ID.
verification: Check Swift package tests + repository integrity and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if the regression test or required CI fails; keep Issue #347 open for the remaining module/tool execution and verification work.
